mapper.select: SELECT e.EMP_ID, e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME, e.EMAIL, e.SALARY, e.STATUS, e.HIRE_DATE, d.DEPT_NAME, j.JOB_TITLE FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_ID = d.DEPT_ID JOIN JOBS j ON e.JOB_ID = j.JOB_ID WHERE e.EMP_ID = #{empId}

SELECT e.EMP_ID, e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME, e.EMAIL, e.SALARY, e.STATUS, e.HIRE_DATE, d.DEPT_NAME, j.JOB_TITLE FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_ID = d.DEPT_ID JOIN JOBS j ON e.JOB_ID = j.JOB_ID WHERE e.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND (e.FIRST_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.LAST_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND e.DEPT_ID = #{deptId}
ORDER BY e.LAST_NAME, e.FIRST_NAME

SELECT e.EMP_ID, e.FIRST_NAME, e.LAST_NAME, e.EMAIL, e.SALARY, e.STATUS, e.HIRE_DATE, d.DEPT_NAME, j.JOB_TITLE FROM EMPLOYEES e JOIN DEPARTMENTS d ON e.DEPT_ID = d.DEPT_ID JOIN JOBS j ON e.JOB_ID = j.JOB_ID WHERE e.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND e.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY e.HIRE_DATE
mapper.update: UPDATE EMPLOYEES SET SALARY = #{newSalary}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE EMPLOYEES SET STATUS = 'TERMINATED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
